purpose: `DeathReport` is a comprehensive, production-ready death and kill tracking package for Nevermore. It provides centralized event orchestration, reactive stream observers (`Observable`), automatic stats tracking, and ultra-compact network replication via **ByteNet** and **PlayerIdService**.
description: `DeathReport` is a comprehensive, production-ready death and kill tracking package for Nevermore. It provides centralized event orchestration, reactive stream observers (`Observable`), automatic stats tracking, and ultra-compact network replication via **ByteNet** and **PlayerIdService**.

DeathReportService.luau.description: Centralized death reporting service which can be used to track deaths on the server. Public entry points include `DeathReportService.Init`, `DeathReportService.Start`, `DeathReportService.AddWeaponDataRetriever`, `DeathReportService.FindWeaponData`, `DeathReportService.ObservePlayerKillerReports`, `DeathReportService.ObservePlayerDeathReports`, `DeathReportService.ObserveHumanoidKillerReports`,…

Server/DeathReportBindersServer.luau.description: Registers server-side death report binders with BinderProvider.

Server/DeathTrackedHumanoid.luau.description: Tracks deaths on humanoids and reports them to DeathReportService. Public entry points include `DeathTrackedHumanoid.new`, `DeathTrackedHumanoid.Destroy`.

Server/Stats/PlayerDeathTracker.luau.description: Server-side tracker for player deaths. Public entry points include `PlayerDeathTracker.new`, `PlayerDeathTracker.Destroy`.

Server/Stats/PlayerKillTracker.luau.description: Server-side tracker for player kills. Public entry points include `PlayerKillTracker.new`, `PlayerKillTracker.GetKillValue`, `PlayerKillTracker.GetPlayer`, `PlayerKillTracker.GetKills`, `PlayerKillTracker.Destroy`.

Server/Stats/PlayerKillTrackerAssigner.l.description: Assigns player kill and death trackers to connecting players. Public entry points include `PlayerKillTrackerAssigner.new`, `PlayerKillTrackerAssigner.GetPlayerKills`, `PlayerKillTrackerAssigner.GetPlayerKillTracker`, `PlayerKillTrackerAssigner.Destroy`.

Server/Stats/TeamKillTracker.luau.description: Server-side tracker for team kills. Public entry points include `TeamKillTracker.new`, `TeamKillTracker.GetTeam`, `TeamKillTracker.GetKills`, `TeamKillTracker.Destroy`.
